provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Duration of Physical Activity: The primary provider did not provide a copy of the promotion of play duration in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Duration of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8)(A))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The primary provider did not provide a copy of the vaccinations for one animal in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience: The primary provider did not provide six hours of management training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The operation did not have a copy of the emergency preparedness plan available for review or provided by email.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO Detection System- One for Each Level of Every Building: During the visit, the primary provider did not have a carbon monoxide detector available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO Detection System- One for Each Level of Every Building (26 TAC §747.5335(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: During the visit, the primary provider did not have an emergency preparedness plan available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience: During the visit, the primary provider did not have any management training hours available for review during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: During the visit, the two children did not have the health statement completed by a parent or guardian.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: During the visit, the primary provider's sleeping cots for children were not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §747.4303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: During the visit, the one child did not have the physician's name or emergency care physician completed by a parent or guardian on the admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission (26 TAC §747.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Duration of Physical Activity: During the visit, the primary provider did not have the duration of promotion of play in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Duration of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the visit, I was informed that there are three household members living on the property who have not submitted a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: During the visit, the primary provider had two dogs inside the front of the home on the property. The primary provider did not have vaccination records available for review. There are two homes on the property.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 1 out of 7 children didnt have emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing: 1 out of 7 children did not have records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing (26 TAC §747.601(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 2 out of 7 children do not have a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: Caregiver lacks training in emergency preparedness and in the prevention and control of communicable diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A safeguard was not in place to prevent children from accessing the back of the operation, where hazardous equipment including a hand saw was located.    There was also an outdoor table with a damaged bench seat that included several exposed screws.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The provider did not have a current copy of the Consumer Product Safety Commission form on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: Documentation of emergency practices were not available for review .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: A/C wall units did not include adequate safeguards to prevent access to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: 3 of 4 student files reviewed did not include a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 3 of 4 student files reviewed did not include an address for emegency contact persons.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: Parents were not notified in writing prior to enrolling children that the operation does not carry liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))
